title: Microsoft Places: availability in the GCC cloud
summary: Hold: the low cost rating describes indirect costs only, although the briefing documents space-licensed capabilities and Microsoft publishes paid Shared Space licensing available in GCC. The availability of Shared Space and Teams Rooms Pro licenses should not remain an open question; GCC release scope, defaults and government user-plan coverage can remain unresolved.

The cited FAQ gives that narrower condition at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/places/frequently-asked-questions, whereas License requirements says active subscriptions.

Both pages are already cited: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/places/what-is-places/buy-set-up-teams-shared-space-licenses-desks and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/places/what-is-places/license-requirements.

claims.claim: The general Places licensing model is mixed: included user-plan core features, per-space premium capabilities and Copilot-licensed AI features.
claims.quote: These features are available to all users with one of these plans. ... these features have shifted to a per-space licensing model ... AI-driven features such as Copilot room booking require a Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.claim: Cost is low, although the cost rationale and body document space-licensed premium capabilities.
claims.quote: cost: "low" ... Low. Core Places features come with the user plans Microsoft lists; individual desk booking (subject to the Teams Premium transition exception until renewal), autorelease and occupancy reports need Teams space licences.
claims.fix: Set cost to 'medium' and replace the cost rationale with: 'Medium. Individual desk booking, autorelease and occupancy reports use per-space licensing, with a transition until renewal for Teams Premium purchased before April 1, 2026. Microsoft publishes paid Teams Shared Space licensing available in GCC; government user-plan coverage for the planned Places core release is not yet published.' Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/places/what-is-places/license-requirements, https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/places/frequently-asked-questions and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/teams-add-on-licensing/teams-shared-device-license. The standard reserves low for indirect cost only.

claims.claim: Whether Teams Shared Space licenses will be available for GCC desks and rooms remains an open question.
claims.quote: The Teams Shared Space license is available to purchase worldwide to commercial, public sector, GCC, GCC High, and DoD tenants.
claims.fix: Remove Teams Shared Space license availability from this open question. State: 'Teams Shared Space is available to purchase in GCC; confirm the tenant's actual purchase price and which space-licensed capabilities are included in the planned Places GCC release.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/teams-add-on-licensing/teams-shared-device-license. The page explicitly covers bookable desks and BYOD rooms; do not present license availability as unpublished.

claims.claim: Whether Teams Room space licenses will be available for GCC rooms remains an open question.
claims.quote: Segment availability | Commercial, Education, Non-Pro | Commercial, Education, Non-Profit, GCC, GCC-High, DoD
claims.fix: Remove Teams Rooms license availability from this open question. State: 'Teams Rooms Pro lists GCC in its segment availability; confirm the tenant's actual purchase price and which space-licensed capabilities are included in the planned Places GCC release.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-licensing. Do not extend GCC availability to Teams Rooms Basic, whose segment list omits GCC.
